verdict.rationale: Anytype documents custom Types as blueprints that define what an Object is, and Properties attached to Objects (bookmark metadata is stored as Properties). Criteria-based Queries return auto-updating Views for retrieval, and Templates keep new Objects consistent. missing for 10: explicit documentation of tags/multi-select properties and property data types, docs on filtering Queries by property values, independent or hands-on corroboration of property-based organization.
